entities.summary: Augusto Pinochet, a notable figure in the history of Chile, associated with From Populism to Allende and the Pinochet Coup (1973–1989). Preceded by Chile becomes neoliberal laboratory under the 'Chicago Boys' and Military coup — Allende dies in La Moneda, September 11, 1973. Their legacy influenced Plebiscite — 'No' campaign defeats Pinochet, October 5, 1988 and Pinochet arrested in London — October 16, 1998.
